test_name: System and Information Integrity - SI-7 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Research-Platform-182
Primary NIST family: System and Information Integrity (SI); evidence focus: SI-7.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: malicious-code protection is centrally managed, updated, monitored, and enabled on applicable workloads. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
